overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair did not anticipate the software topic at the January 9, 2017 meeting, so its omission from the notice was permissible, though postponing such topics is encouraged.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board deliberated on a software issue at its January 9, 2017 meeting that was not listed on the meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: While the complaint argues that the Board could have delayed discussions until a later meeting when proper notice could be given, we note that a public body does not violate the Open Meeting Law by discussing an unanticipated topic during a meeting.
